entities.name: Shifting Wastes
entities.description: Territory of the Abzan Houses and formerly the Dromoka brood on Tarkir, with steppes, hot deserts and shifting sands.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: Dragon whose brood formerly held the region.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: Largest and oldest Abzan fortress city, where the council of houses meets.

entities.name: Qatros Karst City
entities.description: Newest Abzan fortress city, home to House Fenzala's kin-tree; besieged by the Sultai around 4564 AR.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: Faction in conflict over mining rights with Qatros.

entities.name: Anafenza's Kin-Tree
entities.description: First recovered Kin-Tree location from Dromoka's reign.

entities.name: Dusyut Forest
entities.description: Underground forest revealed by a severe sinking.

entities.name: Lookout Roost
entities.description: Watchtower near the Sultai border manned by Vulture-aven.

entities.name: Great Aerie
entities.description: Fortress where Dromoka made her roost.

entities.name: Mer-Ek
entities.description: Fortress that protected Arashin, incorporated into the Great Aerie.

events.summary: A protracted siege of Qatros Karst City by the Sultai over mining rights around 4564 AR kills over a hundred Abzan.
events.quote: A conflict over mining rights with the Sultai Brood led to a protracted siege against the city around 4564 AR

relations.quote: The Shifting Wastes are the territory of the Abzan Houses
Dromoka made her roost in the Great Aerie.
